articles.summary: The Board of Directors of MDU Resources Group, Inc. (NYSE: MDU) today announced that Brian R. Gray has been named president of the company’s wholly owned construction materials subsidiary, Knife River Corporation, effective Jan. 1, 2023.
articles.title: MDU Resources Names Brian Gray President of Knife River Corporation; David Barney Remains CEO

articles.summary: MDU Resources Group, Inc. (NYSE: MDU) today reported third quarter earnings on a generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) basis of $147.9 million, or 73 cents per share, with adjusted earnings of $152.0 million, or 75 cents per share, compared to third quarter 2021 GAAP earnings of $139.3 million, or 68 cents per share. For the nine months ended Sept. 30, MDU Resources on a GAAP basis earned $250.4 million, or $1.23 per share, with adjusted earnings of $254.5 million, or $1.25 per share,
articles.title: MDU Resources Reports Third Quarter Earnings; Knife River Has Record Quarterly Revenue.
